articles.title: Security forces deploy for Italy protests after clashes
articles.description: Security forces have been deployed across Italy ahead of planned protests due to recent violent clashes. Policemen and military personnel have been seen in Milan, as citizens express concern about safety during the protests. Italy's government has approved strict measures targeting protestors, including detaining minors and imposing fines on parents. The protests involve various groups, including truck drivers and students demanding action on living costs.
